newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Tietmeyer says highest oil prices in the past.
newsitem.headline: Tietmeyer says highest oil prices in the past.

text.p: Bundesbank President Hans Tietmeyer said oil prices had already reached their peak, but much of the future price movement would depend on such issues as the situation in Iraq and demand for oil.
Speaking as chairman of the Group of 10 central bank governors' committee, Tietmeyer said the expectation was that oil markets would probably calm down a little.
At their monthly meeting in Basle, the G10 governors were briefed on oil markets by Hamad Saud al-Sayyari, governor of the Saudi Arabian Monetary Authority.

"The highest level is behind us. There has been some decline, but oil prices are still relatively high and much depends on the future of the supplier side, which means the Iraqi question, and further demand," he told reporters.
